cases.purpose: add-fd with explicit -u/-g/-d/-s appends one passwd row, a user private group and a shadow row with an Argon2id PHC and default aging, keeps every existing row, sets passwd/group 0644 and a shadow mode without other access, replaces each file through a new inode without residue; the default uid is unused and >= 1000 with a matching single group; -g with an existing gid uses that group without creating another; a duplicate name changes nothing.
cases.oracle: passwd(5) seven-field and group(5) four-field records, shadow(5) nine fields; shadow-utils semantics as the reference for account tools: useradd(8) (-u/-g/-d/-s, numeric ids in range and not (uid_t)-1, ':' and newline invalid in fields, -g must name an existing group and then no user group is created, the default UID is an unused id >= UID_MIN 1000, a new user's shadow entry uses Debian login.defs PASS_MIN_DAYS 0, PASS_MAX_DAYS 99999, PASS_WARN_AGE 7 with last change = today), userdel(8) (removes passwd, shadow and the user's private group and the user from supplementary member lists; a missing user is an error), passwd -l/-u (prefix or remove a single '!', aging untouched, unlocking to an empty password refused, missing user an error) and chage -d (last-change field only, numeric days). Only private relative PHCLIB_* files are used.
cases.comparison: Exact status and record projections (field values, counts, modes, inode replacement) from in-script awk/stat; diagnostics retained in HOME.
cases.script:
[[ $(type -t passwd) == builtin ]] || { printf 'candidate passwd builtin missing\n'; exit 99; }
export BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0 PHCLIB_PASSWD=db/passwd PHCLIB_SHADOW=db/shadow PHCLIB_GROUP=db/group PHCLIB_M=1024 PHCLIB_T=1 PHCLIB_P=1
reset_db() { /usr/bin/rm -rf db; /usr/bin/mkdir db; /usr/bin/cp pristine/passwd pristine/group pristine/shadow db/; /usr/bin/chmod 600 db/shadow; }
snap() { /usr/bin/rm -rf snap; /usr/bin/cp -a db snap; }
same() { /usr/bin/cmp -s db/passwd snap/passwd && /usr/bin/cmp -s db/group snap/group && /usr/bin/cmp -s db/shadow snap/shadow && echo unchanged || echo changed; }
residue() { local n=0 f; for f in "$1"/* "$1"/.[!.]*; do [[ -e $f ]] || continue; case ${f##*/} in passwd|group|shadow) ;; *) n=$((n + 1)) ;; esac; done; echo "$n"; }
rc_class() { (( $1 == 0 )) && echo 0 || echo nonzero; }
today=$(( $(printf '%(%s)T' -1) / 86400 ))
reset_db
ino() { /usr/bin/stat -c %i "$1"; }
i_p=$(ino db/passwd) i_g=$(ino db/group) i_s=$(ino db/shadow)
size_p=$(/usr/bin/stat -c %s db/passwd) size_g=$(/usr/bin/stat -c %s db/group)
passwd add-fd erin 3 -u 2001 -g 2001 -d /srv/erin -s /bin/sh 3< pw 2> "$HOME/err.add-explicit"; printf 'add-explicit rc=%d\n' "$?"
/usr/bin/awk -F: '$1 == "erin" { printf "passwd rows=1 fields=%d uid=%s gid=%s home=%s shell=%s\n", NF, $3, $4, $6, $7 }' db/passwd
printf 'passwd-erin-rows=%d\n' "$(/usr/bin/grep -c '^erin:' db/passwd)"
printf 'group=[%s]\n' "$(/usr/bin/grep '^erin:' db/group)"
/usr/bin/awk -F: -v t="$today" '$1 == "erin" { h = ($2 ~ /^\$argon2id\$v=19\$m=1024,t=1,p=1\$[0-9a-f]+\$[0-9a-f]+$/) ? "argon2id-phc" : "other"; printf "shadow fields=%d hash=%s lastchg=%s min=%s max=%s warn=%s inactive=[%s] expire=[%s] reserved=[%s]\n", NF, h, ($3 == t ? "today" : $3), $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9 }' db/shadow
/usr/bin/head -c "$size_p" db/passwd | /usr/bin/cmp -s - pristine/passwd && p=kept || p=changed
/usr/bin/head -c "$size_g" db/group | /usr/bin/cmp -s - pristine/group && g=kept || g=changed
/usr/bin/grep -v '^erin:' db/shadow | /usr/bin/cmp -s - pristine/shadow && s=kept || s=changed
printf 'existing-rows passwd=%s group=%s shadow=%s\n' "$p" "$g" "$s"
printf 'modes passwd=%s group=%s shadow-other=%s\n' "$(/usr/bin/stat -c %a db/passwd)" "$(/usr/bin/stat -c %a db/group)" "$(( 8#$(/usr/bin/stat -c %a db/shadow) & 7 ))"
printf 'replaced passwd=%s group=%s shadow=%s\n' "$([[ $(ino db/passwd) != "$i_p" ]] && echo new-inode || echo in-place)" "$([[ $(ino db/group) != "$i_g" ]] && echo new-inode || echo in-place)" "$([[ $(ino db/shadow) != "$i_s" ]] && echo new-inode || echo in-place)"
printf 'residue=%s\n' "$(residue db)"
passwd add-fd finn 3 3< pw 2> "$HOME/err.add-default"; printf 'add-default rc=%d\n' "$?"
uid=$(/usr/bin/awk -F: '$1 == "finn" { print $3 }' db/passwd); gid=$(/usr/bin/awk -F: '$1 == "finn" { print $4 }' db/passwd)
printf 'default uid-unique=%s uid-range=%s gid-groups=%s home=%s\n' \
  "$( (( $(/usr/bin/awk -F: -v u="$uid" '$3 == u' db/passwd | /usr/bin/wc -l) == 1 )) && echo yes || echo no)" \
  "$( [[ $uid =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( uid >= 1000 && uid < 60000 )) && echo ok || echo bad)" \
  "$(/usr/bin/awk -F: -v g="$gid" '$3 == g' db/group | /usr/bin/wc -l)" \
  "$(/usr/bin/awk -F: '$1 == "finn" { print $6 }' db/passwd)"
passwd add-fd gina 3 -g 100 3< pw 2> "$HOME/err.add-existing-group"; printf 'add-existing-group rc=%d\n' "$?"
printf 'existing-group primary=%s groups-with-gid-100=%d gina-group=%s users=[%s]\n' \
  "$(/usr/bin/awk -F: '$1 == "gina" { print $4 }' db/passwd)" "$(/usr/bin/awk -F: '$3 == 100' db/group | /usr/bin/wc -l)" \
  "$(/usr/bin/grep -q '^gina:' db/group && echo present || echo absent)" "$(/usr/bin/grep '^users:' db/group)"
snap
passwd add-fd alice 3 3< pw 2> "$HOME/err.add-duplicate"; printf 'add-duplicate rc=%s files=%s\n' "$(rc_class $?)" "$(same)"
/usr/bin/rm -rf db snap

cases.purpose: When the shadow update fails after passwd and group were rewritten (shadow directory not writable, shadow write EFBIG under RLIMIT_FSIZE, shadow rename onto a directory), add-fd fails and rolls passwd and group back to their exact previous bytes with no temporary files.
cases.oracle: passwd(5) seven-field and group(5) four-field records, shadow(5) nine fields; shadow-utils semantics as the reference for account tools: useradd(8) (-u/-g/-d/-s, numeric ids in range and not (uid_t)-1, ':' and newline invalid in fields, -g must name an existing group and then no user group is created, the default UID is an unused id >= UID_MIN 1000, a new user's shadow entry uses Debian login.defs PASS_MIN_DAYS 0, PASS_MAX_DAYS 99999, PASS_WARN_AGE 7 with last change = today), userdel(8) (removes passwd, shadow and the user's private group and the user from supplementary member lists; a missing user is an error), passwd -l/-u (prefix or remove a single '!', aging untouched, unlocking to an empty password refused, missing user an error) and chage -d (last-change field only, numeric days). Only private relative PHCLIB_* files are used. Account creation is all-or-nothing (useradd removes partial records on failure). setup_script proves each mechanism with independent Python: a caller-owned 0555 directory refuses file creation with EACCES; under ulimit -f 4 with SIGXFSZ ignored an over-limit write is short then EFBIG; rename(file, non-empty directory) fails EISDIR.
cases.comparison: Exact status class, byte comparison of all databases against a pre-call copy, absence of the new user and residue counts.
